buff_text: All attackers gain 45 ranged attack power against this target.
name: Hunter's Mark
description: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the ranged attack power of all attackers against that target by 45 and by an additional 5 each time they are struck by a ranged attack, up to a maximum of 180.  In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible.  The target also appears on the mini-map.  Lasts for 2 min.
